body:
The server serves the COMMITTED web_dist bundle, but web/src has moved past it:
the currency-dialog overflow fix, the login-destination fix (T-43), the sync
indicator (T-47), and the overview open-item counts (T-42) are all missing from
what's actually served. Run `cd web && npm run build` (outputs into
server/src/shoppinglist_server/web_dist/), sanity-check the server webapp tests,
and commit the rebuilt bundle. Consider noting in the workflow that web-source
changes aren't live until a rebuild.
title: Rebuild web_dist: served bundle is stale, missing all of this session's web fixes
